seasons.description: The dark thrill is back at peak intensity — social media cannot stop talking.
seasons.overview: Season 2 finds Dexter caught between two killers, one notorious and the other terrorizing New York in ways no one ever anticipated, all while battling his greatest enemy yet, a mid-life crisis. Harrison continues his own pursuit of justice as father and son face their darkest chapter.

seasons.description: Fresh off its premiere, this slick espionage thriller is dominating Netflix charts tonight.
seasons.overview: Helen is still betraying her nation's secrets to the covert organization she serves: the Black Doves. But after the misadventures of last Christmas, and with her husband Wallace, preparing to become Prime Minister, she is walking a more treacherous line than ever.

seasons.description: High-society drama at its absolute finest — Sunday night television doesn't get better.
seasons.overview: Bertha Russell changed Society at a cost. Now, her family must reckon with the consequences as Agnes van Rhijn seizes an opportunity to regain her position. Meanwhile, Marian forges a new path for herself, and Peggy works to be accepted by her future in-laws. In this new era, you must be careful what you wish for.

seasons.description: Marvel's newest obsession is tearing up fan forums with endless buzz and theories.
seasons.overview: The Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including Friday, Edith, Jarvis, and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepherd, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron's influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he's to survive.

seasons.description: High-stakes political drama packed with sharp banter — impossible not to binge right now.
seasons.overview: In Season Four, two marriages threaten to eat each other alive. One catastrophic moment shatters the fragile peace Kate Wyler brokered between the US and UK, as well as the crumbling marriage she's trying to save. While she fights to stem the bleeding, President Grace Penn and VP Hal Wyler's conspiracy to steal Russia's most powerful weapon hurtles the United States toward war. Kate and Todd, at best an uneasy pair, unite to stop the Grace-Hal alliance from upending the balance of power abroad and at home.

seasons.description: Relentless military action that has Prime Video subscribers glued to their screens tonight.
seasons.overview: Based on the book, True Believer, Season Two finds James Reece searching for a new purpose after finishing his list. But when the CIA corners him, Reece must clear his name by stopping a resurgent terrorist group that has turned an ally to their cause. In this globe-trotting espionage thriller, Reece will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, even to his own family's history.

seasons.description: Charming, stylish, and clever — the ultimate crowd-pleasing heist series returns in top form.
seasons.overview: After four years in prison, Assane is ready to start a new life with his family. But the emergence of a mysterious copycat forces Lupin to return to his most brilliant schemes.

seasons.description: Freshly dropped and hilarious — Apple's witty sports comedy is this week's hidden gem.
seasons.overview: In season two, Santi takes the next step in his pursuit of professional golf, only to discover how quickly the game changes when talent becomes expectation. As Santi chases his dream, Pryce finds himself wondering what might still be possible for him. Urged on by his former rival Clark Ross, Pryce does something nobody expects: he bets on himself, launching an improbable comeback in hopes of becoming the oldest golfer ever to win a major. But the road back proves far harder than he imagined. And the closer Pryce gets to the golfer he once was, the more he is forced to confront why he never fulfilled the promise everyone once saw in him. With brilliant new coach Amanda and trusted caddie Mitts in his corner, Pryce sets out to prove - to the golf world and, more importantly, to himself - that maybe he really was as good as everyone always said he was.

seasons.description: Gritty mob violence and family betrayal making waves across crime drama circles.
seasons.overview: In the second season, the Harrigans struggle to show a unified front as rising rivals threaten their fractured criminal empire – and Harry Da Souza, their street-smart and formidable 'fixer', must walk a dangerous tightrope when tensions within the family intensify. As violence spills into every corner of their lives, loyalties snap, safety proves temporary, and the battle for power leaves no room for mercy.

seasons.description: Sylvester Stallone's swagger carries another wildly entertaining season of pure crime fun.
seasons.overview: In season four, Dwight fights to legitimize his empire and protect his crew as corrupt politicians, dangerous new enemies, and a crushing personal loss hit from every direction. However, every hard-won gain comes with even harder truths: about loyalty, leadership and the cost of ambition. Each move drags Dwight deeper into the street instincts he left behind in New York - turning Tulsa into a battleground and Dwight into the one threat no one can afford to underestimate.

seasons.description: Consistently the smartest spy thriller on television — sharp, darkly funny, and brilliant.
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

seasons.description: HBO delivers a gritty, grounded detective mystery that sci-fi fans are raving about.
seasons.overview: Follows intergalactic cops John Stewart and Hal Jordan as they uncover a dark mystery.

seasons.description: Chilling psychological horror that has genre fans dissecting every terrifying moment online.
seasons.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

seasons.description: A gorgeous, star-studded literary adaptation drawing major awards chatter and critical praise.
Hard-hitting Reacher universe spin-off delivering the explosive action fans were begging for.
seasons.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

seasons.description: High-octane emergencies and shocking drama fueling viral TikTok reactions every single week.
seasons.overview: Explores the high-pressure experiences of the first responders who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations.

seasons.description: Decades in and still serving up peak soapy drama that trends every Thursday.
seasons.overview: A drama centered on the personal and professional lives of five surgical interns and their supervisors.

seasons.description: Still fearlessly roasting current events with hilarious, razor-sharp cultural commentary.
seasons.overview: Join Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny for the historic 29th season of South America.

seasons.description: Reliably gripping medical emergencies and personal stakes keep fans tuning in every week.
seasons.overview: An emotional ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's most explosive hospital and the courageous team of doctors that holds it together. They will tackle unique new cases inspired by topical events, forging fiery relationships in the pulse-pounding pandemonium of the emergency room, and through it all, familiar faces from the Chicago Police and Fire departments will intertwine as this third team of Chicago heroes hits the ground running.

seasons.description: Mariska Hargitay remains unmatched in television's most dependable, socially urgent crime procedural.
seasons.overview: Delves into the dark side of the NYC underworld as the detectives investigate and prosecute various sexually oriented crimes, including rape, pedophilia, domestic violence, and the abuses of children, the disabled, and elderly victims of non-sexual crimes who require specialist handling, all while trying to balance the effects of the investigation on their own lives as they try not to let the dark side of these crimes affect them.

seasons.series_name: Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir
seasons.description: The animated sensation returns with vibrant action delighting its passionate global fandom.
seasons.overview: New heroes. New powers. New enemies. The Miraculous universe will never be the same again. Faced with the greatest threats ever seen, Ladybug and Cat Noir will have to go beyond their limits to protect the world.

seasons.description: Comfort viewing perfection with sharp pop-culture parodies that still hit the mark.
seasons.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

seasons.description: Nostalgic, inventive animated chaos that is pure joy for viewers of all ages.
seasons.overview: Each day, two kind-hearted suburban stepbrothers on summer vacation embark on some grand new project, which annoys their controlling sister, Candace, who tries to bust them. Meanwhile, their pet platypus plots against evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz.

seasons.description: Comfortable, pulse-pounding naval investigations that continue to dominate broadcast ratings.
seasons.overview: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it’s a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

seasons.description: Fast-paced federal takedowns delivering non-stop action for procedural lovers tonight.
seasons.overview: The New York office of the FBI brings to bear all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep their city and the country safe.

seasons.description: Gritty Chicago streets and intense moral dilemmas fuel this fan-favorite crime drama.
seasons.overview: Detective Sergeant Hank Voight and his elite Intelligence Unit at the Chicago Police Department combat atrocious offences and bring criminals to justice.

seasons.description: High-heat rescues and firefighting camaraderie make this seasoned hit a solid watch.
seasons.overview: The lives of firefighters and paramedics working for the City of Chicago Fire Department at Fire Station 51, made up of Truck 81, Squadron 3, Ambulance 61, and Battalion 25.

seasons.description: The classic courtroom and detective formula that defined television procedurals for decades.
seasons.overview: A blended police procedural and courtroom drama which employs a two-part approach: The first half of each episode focuses on NYPD homicide detectives investigating a crime—often derived from a real-life headline—and apprehending a suspect. The second half takes place in the courtroom, with the district attorney prosecuting the defendant.

seasons.description: Tense network crime thriller offering solid weekend intrigue for mystery lovers.
seasons.overview: A unique show from creator Rod Lurie about the life of the mob and the FBI.  Mob boss Jonah Malloy (David Paymer) is trying to run his business away from the interference of the FBI, while the FBI is trying everything to bring down his terror team.  Malloy doesn't know is he has an FBI undercover agent, Roy Ravelle (Anson Mount), working for him. Lisa Cohen (Leslie Hope) heads the FBI team, which also include Paige Van Doren (Leslie Bibb), who lost her husband on 9/11.

seasons.description: A nostalgic college-campus sitcom revival bringing warm laughs and relatable student life.
seasons.overview: In this spin-off from the popular sitcom The Cosby Show, Denise Huxtable enters her sophomore year at Hillman, alma mater of her parents and grandfather, where she moves into Gilbert Hall and shares a dorm room with 26-year-old Jaleesa Vinson and talkative new roommate Maggie Lauten. Also included in the first season cast were obnoxious and extremely wealthy dormmate Whitley Gilbert, ladies' man Dwayne Wayne and dorm director Stevie Rallen. Lettie Bostic later replaced Stevie as the new dorm director. At the end of the first season, Denise would return home (and to The Cosby Show) after dropping out of college. In the fall of 1988, new students Freddie Brooks and Kim Reese entered Hillman College. Freddie was a "hippie-child" who developed a crush on Dwayne; and Kim, an aspiring med student, became Whitley's new roommate. Giving Dwayne a hard time was his math professor, Col. Bradford Taylor.
